final_message:
Configured the requested host and MX records, with all PCs using the lab’s recursive resolver. Existing addresses, routes, and connections were preserved.

The DNS roles are: root on pc1; `com` and `net` on pc2 and pc3; `example.com`, `service.com`, `lab.net`, and `tools.net` on pc10, pc14, pc15, and pc16; resolver on pc17. Those eight PCs now use the BIND image.

Static DNS and startup-script checks passed. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and the lab was not started, so live resolution remains to be verified. The MX records identify mail hosts; they do not configure mail delivery services.
